title: Sunset walk on Buffalo Bayou
old_caption: Libra, the literal partnership sign, took the perfect golden hour walk on Buffalo Bayou alone, then got spun around by a jogging Aries. Pisces sobbing on the far bank. Who's your walk partner?

title: Houston first-date bingo
old_caption: Houston first-date bingo: blames I-45, mentions an ex, phone on the table, 'so what do you do?' Bingo. Again. Every weekend. How many squares did your last date hit?

title: Another Midtown brunch
old_caption: Brunch three: no kids? Brunch seven: moving cities? Brunch twelve: oh, you're not looking for anything serious? The waiter star would like a word about day one questions. What do you ask up front?

title: The energy capital
old_caption: Aries tried rug static, then jumper cables on Leo. The result: one sad puff of smoke and a deeply unimpressed Leo. Turns out you can't force a spark. Which sign tries hardest to make one?

title: "10 minutes away."
old_caption: 5 min. Almost there. Parking. Ok 10 more min. The gold star waited from 6:40 until it grew a cobweb, and then one real question made the wait worth it. What's the wildest 'almost there' you've gotten?

title: Game day
old_caption: Game day turned every star in the stands the same teal. Two fans matched shirts, felt the spark, then the color drained: Aries and Capricorn. Oh. Who matched with you on more than colors?

title: Houston summer
old_caption: Libra melted into a puddle at the car door, then sat through a whole date with someone who replied 'k.' The Sun apologized for the first part. Not the second. What's your summer dealbreaker?

title: Your sign as a Houston hood
old_caption: A star tour of Houston, one sign per neighborhood, and Pisces cried at every single stop, then into Galveston Bay. Leo and Sag ended up a trine across town. Which hood is your sign?

title: Houston humidity
old_caption: Leo's sleek little quiff met Houston humidity and became a full mane. Pisces called it volume. Leo called off the date and put a paper bag on. Who else checks the forecast for their hair?

title: 2 AM taco run
old_caption: Taurus at the truck at 2 AM: one taco, honestly the perfect date. Then the S in the sign burned out and the night got a little too singular. Next run's for two. What's your late-night order?
